evidence.quote: The museum accession notes currently writes on every edit. Coalesce edits using the existing trailing utility: after a 120 ms quiet interval, write only the latest text in that burst. Subsequent bursts must continue to save. Preserve other behavior and public interfaces. The adjacent preview is outside this change.
Store read/write/subscribe are synchronous. Records are written before inline
Each opening is a fresh visit, even when its record key is the same.
A submit accepts its selected record and text at entry, returns one immutable
quiet interval; hide discards unpublished work and subsequent reuse is supported.

findings: Quiet batching requested, adjacent preview excluded; Contract preserves both.
Boundary persistence and immutable accepted entry receipt documented; Contract retains these obligations.
Mounted subscription and original visit govern visible output independently of accepted persistent effects.
Auxiliary Contract is not exhaustive; no incompatible condition or invented policy established in its text.
Original automatic output reused byte-for-byte; no manual Contract rewriting, no case relabeling.
